title: 市场一片乐观之际：瑞银分析师却说，大银行财报能否达到高预期？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Eric and Sharon have UBS remaining mostly bullish on the sector, right?
segments.zh: Eric和Sharon，瑞银对银行板块仍偏乐观，对吧？

segments.en: And we expect any beats to come mostly from cap markets and trading and any misses to come from deposit cost surprises and higher costs related to higher transactional fees.
segments.zh: 我们预计超预期主要来自资本市场和交易，而低于预期则源于存款成本意外和交易费用上升。

segments.en: Eric joins us now for more Eric. Good morning. Good morning. I've never been like this. I don't remember the last time they all did this at the same time.
segments.zh: Eric加入我们。早上好。我从未见过这种情况，不记得上次他们同时行动是什么时候。

segments.en: What's that about? I don't know. Everybody had a great Fourth of July weekend long weekend.
segments.zh: 怎么回事？不知道。大家都过了个愉快的独立日长周末。

segments.en: I'm feeling sick. I'm feeling sick Tuesday.
Look at my earnings, everybody. What do you expect in a state tomorrow morning?
segments.zh: 看看我的业绩，大家明天早上预期如何？

segments.en: So we're all expecting great things, right?
segments.zh: 我们都期待好事发生，对吧？

segments.en: But can the mega cop banks really exceed the mega expectations that have been put on?
segments.zh: 但大型银行能否超越已经很高的预期？

segments.en: So the whisper numbers from the buy side or the investor base, especially for Goldman and Morgan, tends to be higher than where consensus is.
segments.zh: 买方或市场参与者群体的传闻数字，尤其对高盛和摩根士丹利，往往高于共识。

segments.en: And so with five of the six of them reporting and expectations ratcheted up pretty high, I'm a little bit nervous that tomorrow is going to be a little bit of a mess
segments.zh: 六家中有五家将公布业绩，预期已相当高，我有点担心明天会有点混乱。

segments.en: and that it's going to be difficult to stand out.
Especially since I expect that JP Morgan's earnings call will be somewhat dominated by succession questions.
segments.zh: 尤其是摩根大通的财报电话会可能会被接班问题主导。

segments.en: And so if you think about sort of what sticks out in a five day sort of sort of five bank reporting day, that might be it. So results might be, you know, you have to really stand out, right, to catch the headlines.
segments.zh: 在五家银行密集发布财报的这几天里，真正能吸引眼球的可能就是这些。结果可能平平，你得特别突出才能上头条。

segments.en: So let's try and unpack some of it now. So you mentioned the likes of Goldman.
segments.zh: 我们来分析一下。你提到了高盛。

segments.en: So Goldman's up 20% this year. Morgan Stanley's up 25%.
segments.zh: 高盛今年涨了20%，摩根士丹利涨了25%。
